pokedexEntries.go: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

pokedexEntries.si: It has a perfect sense of time. Whatever happens, it keeps rhythm by precisely tilting its head in time.

pokedexEntries.cr: It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some trainers use them in place of clocks.

pokedexEntries.rs: HOOTHOOT has an internal organ that senses and tracks the earth’s rotation. Using this special organ, this POKéMON begins hooting at precisely the same time every day.
